001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import java.util.Objects;
004
005/**
006 * A bot practice setup that can be started again, for example from a rematch button.
007 *
008 * @param ladderName The ladder name, never null
009 * @param arenaName The arena name, or null for an automatically chosen arena
010 * @param winsNeeded Rounds needed to win the match, 1-10
011 * @param options The bot options, never null
012 * @param teamSize Fighters per team, 1-4. The human team is the player (or their party) plus bots; the bot team has this many bots
013 */
014public record BotSetup(String ladderName, String arenaName, int winsNeeded, BotOptions options, int teamSize) {
015
016    public static final int MAX_TEAM_SIZE = 4;
017
018    public BotSetup {
019        Objects.requireNonNull(ladderName, "ladderName");
020        Objects.requireNonNull(options, "options");
021        if (winsNeeded < 1 || winsNeeded > 10) {
022            throw new IllegalArgumentException("winsNeeded must be between 1 and 10");
023        }
024        if (teamSize < 1 || teamSize > MAX_TEAM_SIZE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("teamSize must be between 1 and " + MAX_TEAM_SIZE);
025    }
026
027    public BotSetup(String ladderName, String arenaName, int winsNeeded, BotOptions options) {
028        this(ladderName, arenaName, winsNeeded, options, 1);
029    }
030
031}
